summary: Nodearr sends an anonymous usage report, on by default and easy to turn off, and the totals are public at nodearr.com/stats. A node on 0.10.0 hears of this release by itself and, where it can, installs it: the first release to arrive that way. It sends its first report 6 hours after updating. Until then, Show Report on Settings > General shows exactly what it would send, and Send Anonymous Usage Data beside it turns the report off.

changes.heading: Added
items: Nodearr sends an anonymous usage report to `usage.nodearr.com` every 6 hours, as Sonarr and Radarr send theirs: the version and platform, how it was installed, the kinds and versions of the Arr apps connected, and how transfers went over the past week. Every count is a range, the report's ID changes every day at midnight UTC, and nothing in it names your node, your friends, your titles or your addresses. The totals are public at nodearr.com/stats ([#133](https://github.com/Nodearr/Nodearr/issues/133), [Privacy and security](https://github.com/Nodearr/Nodearr/blob/v0.11.0/docs/user-guide/privacy-and-security.md#anonymous-usage-report), [ADR 0024](https://github.com/Nodearr/Nodearr/blob/v0.11.0/docs/adr/0024-update-checks-and-usage-reports-on-nodearr-com.md#2026-11-06-usage-reports-are-built-133)).

Settings > General has a Usage Data section: Send Anonymous Usage Data, on by default and also set by `Nodearr__Usage__Send`, and Show Report, which shows the exact report the next run would send. Contact nodearr.com off stops the report too ([#133](https://github.com/Nodearr/Nodearr/issues/133), [Settings](https://github.com/Nodearr/Nodearr/blob/v0.11.0/docs/user-guide/settings.md#usage-data)).

The code of `usage.nodearr.com`, which takes in the reports, keeps no addresses and publishes daily totals, is in `usage/`, with the report's schema ([#133](https://github.com/Nodearr/Nodearr/issues/133)).

changes.heading: Removed
items: The AnalyticsEnabled setting inherited from Sonarr, and its environment key `Nodearr__Log__AnalyticsEnabled`. It did nothing in Nodearr; Send Anonymous Usage Data is the one setting for usage data now ([#133](https://github.com/Nodearr/Nodearr/issues/133)).
